findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kyrodata_fetch, kyrodata_get_heading_overview, kyrodata_search · Private data: kyrodata_fetch, kyrodata_get_credit_balance, kyrodata_get_heading_overview, kyrodata_resolve_entity, kyrodata_run_report, kyrodata_search · Public sink: kyrodata_explain_pyramid_level, kyrodata_list_trade_partners · Destructive: kyrodata_run_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kyrodata_fetch, kyrodata_get_heading_overview, kyrodata_search · Private data: kyrodata_fetch, kyrodata_get_credit_balance, kyrodata_get_heading_overview, kyrodata_resolve_entity, kyrodata_run_report, kyrodata_search · Public sink: kyrodata_explain_pyramid_level, kyrodata_list_trade_partners · Destructive: kyrodata_run_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
